bio: In the city centre, opposite the brick-built Gothic town hall, is the Inspektorenhaus, from which the inspector used to keep an eye on the market and the activity it harboured. Nowadays it is a restaurant with a cosy ambience and distinct charm, thanks to old wooden beams and pretty decorations. In summer, you can sit outside in the courtyard garden. Two seasonal set menus are served, one with fish, one with meat. Friendly service....
